title: Terto hub
features: Just auto farm if u want

changelog.message: local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait() local RootPart = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")  _G.AutoFarm = true -- Set to false to stop  spawn(function()     while _G.AutoFarm do         wait(0.1)         -- This logic finds the nearest NPC         for _, npc in pairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do             if npc:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and npc.Humanoid.Health > 0 then                 repeat                     -- Teleports you behind the NPC                     RootPart.CFrame = npc.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)                                          -- Triggers the attack remote (This name changes per update)                     local args = { [1] = "Attack", [2] = npc }                     game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Validator:FireServer(unpack(args))                                          wait()                 until not _G.AutoFarm or npc.Humanoid.Health <= 0             end         end     end end)
